A dozen pairs of glowing eyes blink open in the blackness beyond the torchlight, low and many and closing in.
A massive spider the size of a horse descends slowly on a thread from the dark ceiling above the party.
A towering troll-shape looms half-seen in the gloom of the far archway, hunched and breathing and waiting.
Bones scrape against stone as a skeletal guardian drags itself upright from the burial alcove, jaw working in silence.
A coiled shadow-serpent shifts in the darkness beneath the floor grating, scales whispering, a single eye catching the light.
Small hunched shapes creep along the tunnel walls in a mass, their yellow eyes blinking, their chatter barely a whisper.
Something long and pale slides from beneath the black water's surface, curling once around the nearest pillar before going still.
A cold mist gathers at the chamber's far end, pulling slowly inward, taking a shape that is almost a figure.
A massive stone form in the alcove has shifted slightly, one arm no longer where it was a moment ago.
The ceiling erupts in a shrieking black wave of wings, leathery and frantic, blotting the torchlight entirely for a terrible moment.
Something enormous breathes in the dark beyond the pillars, and the shadow it casts has horns and the weight of a wall.
The iron-bound chest in the center of the room has no lock, and it just moved, just slightly, toward the door.
A robed figure sits motionless on a throne of black stone far ahead, eye sockets faintly luminous, watching without blinking.
A pale hand the length of a forearm grips the dungeon's ceiling crack overhead, then a second hand reaches and grips again.
In the collapsed corridor, two burning amber eyes float at chest height, unblinking, attached to nothing the torchlight can quite reach.
The dungeon pool bulges upward as something vast and formless shifts beneath, and the ripples move outward like a slow warning.
A figure stands just inside the far doorway, translucent and still, wearing armor that rusted to dust three centuries ago.
The iron portcullis bends inward with a slow groan, something on the other side pressing calmly through the bars without hurry.
Fungal growths along the wall pulse with a faint bioluminescence, and the largest cluster has begun to slowly lean toward the party.
A humanoid shape clings flat against the ceiling above the treasure pile, perfectly motionless, watching with lidless eyes as the party enters.
From the pit's depths below the rope bridge, something enormous inhales, and the torches gutter sideways all at once toward the hole.
The dungeon wall itself ripples, a massive worm-shape pressing outward from within the stone, then stilling, as if reconsidering its moment.
A wolf-sized rat crouches at the tunnel's edge, enormous and unafraid, regarding the party with an intelligence that has no business there.
The hanging chains in the torture chamber sway despite no wind, and a low sound rises that is not quite a voice.
Far down the corridor, a silhouette stands where the map shows no room, no door, no passage, nothing that should be there.
